Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 4
Reason for Mistake: The WebSurfer failed to extract the required information from the Wikipedia page in Step 4. Although the Wikipedia page was successfully opened and the viewport clearly displayed the sentence "Harland was educated at The Dragon School in Oxford and Haileybury. He then went to university at Peterhouse, Cambridge, taking a law degree," the agent did not copy or quote this text as instructed by the Planner. Instead, the agent immediately navigated away to the Telegraph URL without recording the evidence from Wikipedia. This failure to capture the exact wording from an accessible, authoritative source (Wikipedia) in Step 4 was the first critical error that prevented the task from being completed with the required citations, forcing the agent into a repetitive loop of trying to access the paywalled Telegraph article.
